Hi Vanessa,

BrightBank needs to submit a customer data erasure request for account BRIGHT-1245. The attached signed form lists "user-generated prompts and generated model outputs" and asks for confirmation of timing and scope.

1) By "generated outputs" do you delete model responses that were returned to users and also any intermediate cached KV? 
2) What's Redwood's default retention window for requests & responses on hosted vs dedicated deployments? 
3) How do you confirm completion — signed confirmation or a GDrive export link with redacted artifacts?

I've attached the signed-erasure for your review (signed-erasure-BRIGHT-1245.pdf).

Samuel

BrightBank

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Ortiz <samuel@brightbank.com>
Cc: procurement@brightbank.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data erasure request for BRIGHT-1245 — prompts & outputs

Hi Samuel — thanks for the form and the clear questions. Quick answers up front, then next steps below.

Short answers:
- What is covered: "prompts" (user request payloads) and "generated outputs" (model responses returned to user) are in scope for the erasure you requested. That includes transient request logs and stored response artifacts.
- KV/streaming caches: short-lived KV caches used for active sessions are ephemeral and not part of persistent logs by default; persistent KV snapshots (if enabled by your integration) are considered derived artifacts and we'll need to confirm if you have that option enabled.
- Default retention windows: for hosted API requests/responses we retain request and response logs for 30 days by default; for Dedicated deployments the tenant may configure retention — the default Redwood-managed image for Dedicated is 90 days unless the customer has overridden it in the deployment config.
- Confirmation method: we provide a deletion report and an export of redacted identifiers (if requested). We can also provide a signed confirmation PDF.

Proposed next steps (I can start this process next business day once you confirm):
1) Please confirm you approve deletion of all prompts & outputs for BRIGHT-1245, and whether you want a full export of remaining hashed identifiers.
2) If you want exports, let us know the preferred delivery method (secure GDrive link or SFTP).
3) We'll open an internal erasure runbook, schedule the purge window, and notify you when the job completes (estimated within 5 business days after receiving signed confirmation).

Cc'ing Kimberly (Security) to assist with the runbook and Jordan (Customer Success) for export coordination.

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachment: erase-request-template.pdf (PDF)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Data erasure request — BRIGHT-1245 (action required)

Kimberly, Jordan — forwarding the signed request from BrightBank. Quick internal plan and asks below. Please keep this thread internal for operational details.

Scope described by customer: prompts + generated outputs for account BRIGHT-1245.
Known constraints: BrightBank is hosted (no Dedicated override) and has standard embeddings indexing enabled (they store embeddings snapshots in our artifact store).

Action items:
- Kimberly: please confirm whether the embeddings snapshots must be deleted as part of the customer request or treated as a separate derivative with special handling. If deletion is required, confirm SRE steps to remove from long-term blob store; consider pending legal/contract hold.
- Jordan: prepare export template (redaction applied to PII) and a secure GDrive link placeholder. Also draft the signed confirmation PDF template we send after purge completes.
- Ops/SRE (please triage in parallel): schedule a purge job for the 30-day-hosted retention bucket and a targeted run for any artifacts linked to BRIGHT-1245 (logs + response artifacts + embeddings if approved). Provide estimated completion time.

Notes on technical scope:
- Persistent request/response logs: located in prod-logs/region-us-west/requests/BRIGHT-1245 — scheduled purge will remove these objects.
- Streaming KV caches: not persisted beyond session by default; confirm customer hasn't enabled session snapshotting.
- Audit & billing records: not part of erasure (we retain billing records and audit trail per legal; we will provide redacted indicators instead).

Target timeline: await Samuel's confirmation; once received, aim to complete purge within 5 business days. I'll coordinate with legal if they push for immediate action.

-V

Thanks for confirming. This is to confirm the erasure job for BRIGHT-1245 completed today, 2026-03-10.

What we deleted (scope you requested):
- Prompts (user-submitted request payloads stored in request logs)
- Model-generated outputs that were persisted as artifacts in the request/response log store

What was not deleted (by policy/legal exceptions):
- Billing records and invoicing history (retained for statutory accounting, redacted reference available on request)
- System audit logs required for incident investigations (we can provide redacted indicators and the time windows but cannot expose full content)

Artifacts provided:
- Export of redacted identifiers and a short deletion report: https://drive.redwood.com/exports/BRIGHT-1245-erasure-20260310 (access expires in 7 days)
- Deletion confirmation (signed): deletion-confirmation-BRIGHT-1245.pdf (attached)

If you want us to remove embeddings snapshots that were generated for BRIGHT-1245, that requires an additional run (we did not remove embeddings in this job). Please let us know and we'll schedule it; expect an additional 3–4 business days for blob-store removal and index rebuilds.

If you want a formal SLA exception or legal statement, loop in BrightBank Legal and we'll coordinate with our Legal team.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
